{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm that 'revenue' is string with commas
print("Sample of revenue values:")
print(df['revenue'].head(10))

# Strip commas and convert to float
# But first: check if any have multiple commas or malformed values
malformed = df['revenue'].str.count(',') > 1
if malformed.any():
    print("Malformed revenue values (more than one comma):")
    print(df.loc[malformed, 'revenue'])
else:
    print("No malformed revenue values (multiple commas).")

# Proceed to clean: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Verify the conversion
print("\nSample of cleaned revenue:")
print(df['revenue_clean'].head())"}
